camel_example: aliyun alb UnTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'alb-gws76zij000000' --ResourceType loadbalancer --method POST --force
description_zh: 删除资源上配置的标签
kebab_example: aliyun alb un-tag-resources --resource-type loadbalancer --resource-id alb-gws76zij000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UnTagResources

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

acl: an access control list (ACL)
loadbalancer: an Application Load Balancer (ALB) instance
securitypolicy: a security policy
servergroup: a server group
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型，取值：

acl：访问控制。

loadbalancer：应用型负载均衡实例。

securitypolicy：安全策略。

servergroup：服务器组
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the resources from which you want to remove tags
parameters.help_zh: 要删除标签的资源ID列表
parameters.name: resource_id

fields.help_en: The key of the tag that you want to remove. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. The tag key cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`
fields.help_zh: 要删除标签的标签键。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the tag that you want to remove. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. The tag value cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`
fields.help_zh: 要删除标签的标签值。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags that you want to remove
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The keys of the tags that you want to remove
parameters.help_zh: 要删除标签的标签键列表
parameters.name: tag_key

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to remove all tags from the specified resource. Valid values:

true
false
parameters.help_zh:
是否解绑资源的所有标签。取值：

true：解绑资源的所有标签。
false（默认值）：不解绑资源的所有标签
parameters.name: all
